description: Lints a whole wireframe document against the component schemas — for example flagging text that will overflow its element. Findings are non-fatal warnings, never exceptions, so an agent can decide what to act on.

members.name: Lint
members.type: static IReadOnlyList<WireframeLintWarning> Lint(WireframeDocument document, WireframeSchemaRegistry registry, WireframeComponentScope? scope = null)
members.description: Lints every page of the document and returns all findings.

examples.title: Lint a document
